cues.en: Okay. My name is Drew and I'll be showing you a quick tour of Dropbox which is a new way to store and share files online.
cues.zh: 好，我叫Drew，接下来我带大家快速体验一下Dropbox，这是一种在线存储和分享文件的新方式。

cues.en: What makes Dropbox different is that it just works and there isn't any complicated setup or interface to learn.
cues.zh: Dropbox的与众不同之处在于它开箱即用，没有复杂的设置或界面需要学习。

cues.en: So let's get started.
cues.zh: 那我们开始吧。

cues.en: Already installed Dropbox on a Windows PC and put a bunch of files in and now I want to sync these files to my Mac. So to do that I just installed Dropbox and now I'm linking my Mac to my account.
cues.zh: 我已经在Windows电脑上装好了Dropbox，放了一堆文件进去，现在我想把这些文件同步到我的Mac上。为此我装好了Dropbox，现在正把Mac关联到我的账户。

cues.en: So in a second my account will be linked and you can see that the files that were on my Windows PC will start coming down.
cues.zh: 稍等片刻账户就会关联好，你会看到Windows电脑上的文件开始下载过来。

cues.en: And what we're looking at is my Dropbox folder which looks and acts like any other folder except for two things. One, these little green icons that indicate files are up to date. And two, anything in my Dropbox is synced across all of my computers into the web.
cues.zh: 现在我们看到的是我的Dropbox文件夹，它看起来和用起来都跟普通文件夹一样，但有两点不同。第一，这些小绿色图标表示文件已是最新状态。第二，我Dropbox里的任何内容都会同步到我所有电脑以及网页上。

cues.en: And you'll notice that when I make changes everything syncs up pretty quickly.
cues.zh: 你会注意到，当我做出修改时，一切都会很快同步。

cues.en: And as another example, I'm going to log in my Windows PC
cues.zh: 再举个例子，我登录我的Windows电脑

cues.en: where you'll see that not only are the changes from my Mac already here but if I make another change to a file, so for example this picture of a platypus
cues.zh: 你会看到不仅Mac上的修改已经同步过来了，而且如果我再修改一个文件，比如这张鸭嘴兽的图片

cues.en: and then I hit save,
cues.zh: 然后我点击保存，

cues.en: the change begins uploading immediately.
cues.zh: 修改立刻就开始上传了。

cues.en: And
cues.zh: 然后

cues.en: when I go back to my Mac,
cues.zh: 当我回到Mac上，

cues.en: the change is reflected in a matter of seconds.
cues.zh: 几秒钟之内修改就反映出来了。

cues.en: So the point is if you've ever worked with multiple computers or carried around speed drive or emailed yourself files from work, you can see this is a much easier way of managing your stuff. And we also protect you from the bad things that can happen to your files. So if I delete a bunch of stuff,
cues.zh: 所以重点是，如果你曾经用过好几台电脑、随身带U盘，或者从公司给自己发邮件传文件，你就能看出这是管理文件轻松得多的方式。我们还会保护你的文件免受各种意外损害。比如我删掉一堆东西，

cues.en: we have this web interface
cues.zh: 我们有这个网页界面

cues.en: where you can not only get to your files in case you're not at one of your computers. So here are the contents of my Dropbox here.
cues.zh: 在这里你不仅可以访问你的文件，即使你不在自己的某台电脑前也行。这就是我Dropbox里的内容。

cues.en: But we have the show deleted files link where you can select a file that you've deleted and then you have an option to bring it back
cues.zh: 但我们有一个“显示已删除文件”的链接，点进去可以选中已删除的文件，然后就能把它找回来

cues.en: in a couple of clicks. So I'll do that and instantly the file's back.
cues.zh: 只需点两下。我现在操作一下，文件立马就恢复了。

cues.en: And not only do you have the option of restoring the most recent version but actually any prior version of a file
cues.zh: 而且你不仅能恢复最新版本，还能恢复文件的任意历史版本

cues.en: because every time you make a change Dropbox saves a snapshot.
cues.zh: 因为每次修改，Dropbox 都会保存一份快照。

cues.en: And Dropbox is also very efficient about the way it handles changes to files and sends only the pieces that change. So in the case of the platypus picture just sending the delta saved over 80% of the bandwidth.
cues.zh: 此外 Dropbox 处理文件修改也非常高效，只传输变动的部分。以这张鸭嘴兽的图片为例，仅传输增量就节省了 80% 以上的带宽。

cues.en: So that covers a lot of how we make it easy to access and protect your own files but the other half of what we do revolves around making it really easy to share and put files online.
cues.zh: 以上大部分是在讲如何便捷地访问和保护自己的文件，而我们的另一半重点，是让文件的在线分享变得极其简单。

cues.en: So normally if I want to share something I have to send an email attachment or something like that. But Dropbox has a special public folder
cues.zh: 平时如果想分享内容，通常得发邮件附件什么的。但 Dropbox 有一个专门的公开文件夹

cues.en: where every file you put in here has a URL associated with it. So I can get a public link
cues.zh: 放进这里的每个文件都会对应一个 URL。我可以获取一个公开链接

cues.en: and then I can paste that into an I'm window or an email
cues.zh: 然后粘贴到聊天窗口、邮件

cues.en: or a blog post and it does what you'd expect.
cues.zh: 或者博客文章里，效果完全符合预期。

cues.en: So it's great for individual files but we also make it possible to share entire folders.
cues.zh: 用来分享单个文件很方便，但我们同样支持共享整个文件夹。

cues.en: So all I have to do is right click any folder
cues.zh: 我只需要右键点击任意文件夹

cues.en: and then there's this option
cues.zh: 然后选择

cues.en: to share.
cues.zh: 共享。

cues.en: And then all I have to do is enter an email addresses of people I want to share the folder with.
cues.zh: 接下来只要输入对方的邮箱地址就行了。

cues.en: And then when I hit share, the folder that's on my computer will also appear on their desktops.
cues.zh: 然后当我点击共享时，我电脑上的文件夹也会出现在他们的桌面上。

cues.en: And as a better example of this, I'll actually accept an invitation from one of my friends who invited me to join his shared folder.
cues.zh: 作为更好的例子，我实际上会接受一位朋友的邀请，他邀请我加入他的共享文件夹。

cues.en: So when I hit accept,
cues.zh: 所以当我点击接受时，

cues.en: inside my Dropbox
cues.zh: 在我的Dropbox里

cues.en: there'll appear this Dropbox trade secrets folder
cues.zh: 会出现这个Dropbox商业机密文件夹

cues.en: with files from his computer in there.
cues.zh: 里面包含他电脑上的文件。

cues.en: And then when I put files inside,
cues.zh: 然后当我放入文件时，

cues.en: those will appear on his desktop instantly.
cues.zh: 这些文件会立即出现在他的桌面上。

cues.en: And then when I refresh,
cues.zh: 然后当我刷新时，

cues.en: you can see the changes reflected.
cues.zh: 你可以看到变化反映出来。

cues.en: Okay. So shared folders are great for collaborating on projects or sharing documents or photos or music or any kind of file.
cues.zh: 好了。所以共享文件夹非常适合协作项目或共享文档、照片、音乐或任何类型的文件。

cues.en: But the last thing I'm gonna show you is the easiest way to put photos online. So Dropbox comes with this built in photo gallery which is probably a lot like the ones you've seen before
cues.zh: 但我要展示给你的最后一件事是将照片放到网上的最简单方法。所以Dropbox内置了这个照片画廊，可能和你之前见过的很像

cues.en: except that the difference is ours is tightly integrated into the desktop.
cues.zh: 不同之处在于我们的与桌面紧密集成。

cues.en: And I'll show you what I mean.
cues.zh: 我来展示一下我的意思。

cues.en: So if you have a folder full of photos like this one here,
cues.zh: 所以如果你有一个充满照片的文件夹，就像这里的这个，

cues.en: all you have to do is drag it into the special photos folder inside your Dropbox.
cues.zh: 你只需将其拖到Dropbox内的特殊照片文件夹中。

cues.en: And when you refresh the photo gallery,
cues.zh: 当你刷新照片画廊时，

cues.en: Dropbox actually creates a photo album with the same name.
cues.zh: Dropbox实际上会创建一个同名的相册。

cues.en: And all of your albums include these secret links that you can then share.
cues.zh: 你所有的相册都包含这些秘密链接，你可以分享它们。

cues.en: So hopefully that gives you an idea of how much easier Dropbox makes it to share files.
cues.zh: 希望这能让你了解Dropbox让共享文件变得多么容易。

cues.en: And with that we'll wrap up. We're still in private beta but you can visit us and sign up to give it a shot at www.getdropbox.com.
cues.zh: 到此我们就结束了。我们仍在私人测试阶段，但你可以访问我们并注册试用，网址是www.getdropbox.com。

cues.en: Thanks.
cues.zh: 谢谢。
